newsitem.title: USA: Centennial Technologies faces another suit.
newsitem.headline: Centennial Technologies faces another suit.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc on Thursday was named in another class-action lawsuit filed on behalf of investors who purchased the company's stock between August 21 and February 10.

The complaint, filed in a Massachusetts court, accuses Centennial with violations of the Securities Exchange Act. It alleges the company issued materially false and misleading financial statements that overstated its financial condition, causing the price of Centennial securities to be inflated and injuring investors.
The plaintiffs seek to recover damages on behalf of all class members and are represented by the law firm of Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP, among others.

Earlier Thursday, Centennial said it would restate its financial results for fiscal 1994, 1995 and 1996 and the first two quarters of fiscal 1997. It said it expected to report "material cumulative losses" for the periods.
It also said a committee set up by the company was still probing the activities of Emanuel Pinez, its founder and former chief executive.
The company faces at least three other suits seeking to recover damages on behalf of all persons who bought stock during the same period.
